name: IBM watsonx.ai
short: IBM's enterprise AI studio running its Granite foundation models alongside third-party Meta, Google, DeepSeek and Mistral models, with a Free plan for playground usage and pay-as-you-go production billing.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Toolbox playground: foundation models up to 300,000 tokens per month, machine-learning tools up to 20 compute-usage hours (CUH) per month, text extraction up to 100 documents per month.

plans.name: Essentials (Pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Production deployments billed per million tokens across IBM and third-party foundation models (e.g. granite-8b-code-instruct USD 0.636, llama-4-maverick-17b fp8 USD 0.371/USD 1.484, gpt-oss-120b USD 0.159/USD 0.636, mistral-large-2512 USD 0.636/USD 1.908), plus hourly on-demand hosting (L40S USD 4.43/hr to H200 USD 16/hr); embedding models USD 0.106 per million tokens.

plans.name: Standard (Pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Enterprise production tier with the same per-token model pricing plus platform and support features.
